done_when: forge test runs the configured test command on Windows for a forge.toml that PowerShell or Windows tools wrote, and a repo with no test command still says so

known.title: Gate: Include the Windows regression in platform test selection

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - running the full suite or Windows CI.
This test lacks `@pytest.mark.platform`. Its CRLF case triggers the platform-sensitive policy in tests/test_platform_sensitive_selection.py:40–45, so that existing check fails. Windows CI also uses `-m platform` (.github/workflows/forge-next.yml:135), which excludes this regression entirely. Add the platform marker so the policy passes and Windows runs the promised coverage. The claimed pull-request Windows proof also needs an actual check: the Windows job currently runs only on schedule or workflow_dispatch (line 70).
